packageRules.description: Auto merge GitHub Actions updates
Auto merge terraform updates
Auto merge Go module updates
Auto merge Docker tags in CI and app Dockerfiles
Auto merge npm updates in .github

Auto merge non-critical-infrastructure cluster updates. Renovate (not GitHub-native automerge) does the merge, so every reported check (validate, flate test/diff, renovate/stability-days) must be green, not just the required validate check. Releases must be 3 days old, and merges land in the 6 PM-6 AM CT window that running-workload changes already follow.
Custom managers track nonstandard sources; require review unless a later rule opts them in (cluster-tree minor/patch below, Kometa, webtop tool pins, Tailscale workflow pin, Aqua registry).

Auto merge minor/patch updates from custom managers that track plain app images, tools, and release-tagged assets in the cluster tree. Majors still need review. Coupled or critical custom-manager deps (Talos/kubelet pins, CNPG engine images, CNI, storage, backups, cluster-coupled webtop pins) are switched back off by later rules.
Group ARC controller and runner scale set together
Auto merge Kometa community configuration assets after the render gate passes.
Auto merge bot/webtop maintainer-image tool pins (Go, Node, uv, agents, CLIs). These only feed a manually triggered/weekly image build, not a cluster workload. Minor/patch only.

Cluster-coupled pins in the webtop image (kubectl tracks the fleet API server, talosctl tracks Talos, flux tracks the Flux operator) always need human review. Must stay after the webtop automerge rule.
Auto merge the Tailscale client pinned in the workflow_dispatch-only status-check workflow.
Auto merge TeslaMate application and dashboard updates after the render gate passes.
Apps released from the review list (Immich, Mimir and its dashboards, homer-operator, dragonfly-operator) automerge minor/patch only; majors still need review.
Aqua package updates require a matching generated checksum file.
prBodyNotes: Run `aqua update-checksum --prune` and commit `aqua-checksums.json` before merging.

packageRules.description: Auto merge Aqua registry updates after the generated checksum file is updated and verification passes.
Do not update runtime images independently inside generated or vendored manifests; regenerate the complete upstream bundle instead. Review-by: 2026-10-10.
Do not update Docker-like image or version values in Mimir alert-rule test fixtures; rules/tests/ contains promtool data, not deployed images. Review-by: 2026-10-10.
Exclude legacy tags with 4-digit build numbers in patch position
Exclude legacy Ubuntu-based tags (20.04.x, 22.04.x) for qbittorrent

Rook and Ceph are grouped per cluster in .renovate/groups.json — one storage rollout at a time. Ceph encodes release type in the minor field (x.0.z development, x.1.z release candidates, x.2.z stable — https://docs.ceph.com/en/latest/releases/general/), so only x.2.z may be proposed. An RC carries no prerelease suffix, so ignoreUnstable cannot see it: v21.1.0 was offered and merged as if stable, and Rook refused it cluster-wide.
Track code-server with build suffix (format: 4.109.2-39)
Track Omnibus fork builds as upstream major.minor.patch plus a fourth fork-build component; never compare them as ordinary upstream patch releases.
CloudNativePG compound tags encode PostgreSQL major and extension version; keep Renovate on the current compatibility line.

CRITICAL REVIEW BLOCK (keep last). Presets in extends (groups.json) are applied before this file, so any automerge rule here overrides a group-level automerge:false; the review rules therefore sit at the end and win. Only the narrow, explicitly non-critical exceptions after them may re-enable automerge. Paths: Talos/Kubernetes bootstrap, Flux, CNI (Cilium, Multus, Whereabouts, Spiderpool), storage/CSI (Rook-Ceph, cephcsi, csi-addons, local-path, snapshot-controller), Garage and garage-operator, CNPG and its barman backup plugin, Kopiur backups, cert-manager, Tailscale, tuppr, GPU operator/DRA, and Envoy Gateway (public ingress with Maglev+DSR and the real-client-IP rule: chart, CRDs, EnvoyProxy/Gateway config).

Critical families by package, wherever they appear. Restates the automerge:false intent of the critical groups in .renovate/groups.json (Talos, Kubernetes, Rook, Ceph, tuppr, Flux, flux-operator/instance, Multus, csi-driver-smb, Talhelper, snapshot-controller, CNPG engine images) plus Envoy Gateway, so a broad automerge rule in this file can never silently override them.
Never automerge commit-pinned Git references (restates the groups.json rule so it wins).
Auto merge Kopiur chart upgrades. The published chart carries the controller, webhook, and mover image digests for the chart release; inherit them so Renovate opens one effective update.

Non-CNI components that live in the cilium-* and csi-* trees (Intel GPU device plugin, NodeLocal DNSCache, Secrets Store CSI driver) may automerge minor/patch after the gates pass. Majors still need review. Must stay after the critical review block.
Envoy Gateway Grafana dashboards are release-tagged JSON assets, not ingress; they may automerge minor/patch after the gates pass. Majors still need review.
